info.title: LMS Nhóm 2 API
info.description: D2 review draft for CP1. Paths are relative to /api. x-roles names permitted actors; every resource operation also requires class membership or ownership checks. Client Log #18–#20 rules are approved: grading locks further submissions, grades may be corrected with complete history, and publishing is atomic for the whole assignment with automatic zeroes for active students who did not submit. Creating or reactivating an enrollment for an assignment already published atomically creates any missing Published zero result while preserving existing grades/history and without fabricating a submission; submission access stays locked. Assignment-wide publisher provenance is database-only. Resubmission closes at the current deadline and reopens only when a teacher extends that deadline; a first submission may still be late. Submission time is the server-side successful atomic commit time. Scores use at most two decimal places. Rules still marked x-decision-pending are not approved. The mock returns examples only and does not enforce security or persist data.

post.description: Active duplicate enrollment returns 409. Re-enrollment reactivates the same inactive enrollment ID; all submission/grade history is preserved. For assignments already published, enrollment creation atomically creates any missing Published 0 result, preserving existing grades and history and fabricating no submission or submission version; submission access stays locked. Deactivation blocks student class access; assigned teachers retain access to historical work.

post.summary: Upload one private allowlisted file before attaching it to a visible resource
post.description: The backend streams the file to private S3-compatible storage without buffering or executing it, normalizes the final extension, and verifies that declared MIME and detected content are consistent. A successful upload creates a PENDING file owned by the actor. Attaching it atomically to one visible resource changes it to ATTACHED. Unattached PENDING files expire after 24 hours; failed object deletion moves them to DELETE_PENDING for retry. Executables, direct system scripts, macro-enabled office files, extensionless files and unrecognized extensions return 415.

post.summary: Atomically create an immutable submission version within the applicable submission rule
post.description: A first submission is accepted even after deadlineAt and is marked Late. After a student has submitted, another version is accepted only when the server-side successful commit time is at or before the assignment's current deadlineAt; extending deadlineAt can therefore reopen resubmission. The server returns 409 DEADLINE_LOCKS_RESUBMISSION after that boundary. Any Draft or Published grade takes precedence and permanently returns 409 GRADE_LOCKS_SUBMISSION. A version contains at most 10 distinct files and 100 MiB total. All files must be PENDING, owned by the actor and unattached; the version, file links and transition to ATTACHED commit atomically. A failed commit creates no version. submittedAt is the server completion time of that successful commit and deadlineAtSubmission snapshots the current deadline used for the check.

put.summary: Create or update a grade and append complete immutable history
put.description: The graded version must be the current submission version. Creating a grade locks further submissions immediately. Every successful create or change appends an immutable history entry, including Draft changes and corrections to Published grades. Updating a Published grade keeps it Published and makes the correction visible to the student; it is not rejected merely because it was already published. Student history endpoints continue to filter out every Draft revision.

post.summary: Atomically publish results for every active student in the class
post.description: Publish succeeds only when every submitted assignment has a current grade. In one transaction it publishes all graded results, creates and publishes score 0 results with source AUTO_ZERO_NO_SUBMISSION for active enrolled students who did not submit, records history, and creates notifications. For assignments already published, enrollment creation or reactivation atomically creates any missing Published 0 result while preserving existing grades and history; it fabricates no submission or version, and submission access stays locked. If any submitted work is ungraded, no result is published and 409 returns the blockers.

LoginResult.description: HS256 access JWT (15 minutes). A rotated opaque refresh token is sent only as HttpOnly cookie lms_refresh (7-day absolute lifetime). Reusing a spent refresh token revokes its entire session. Logout, password change/reset and account deactivation revoke access immediately. Keep accessToken in frontend memory. Cookie refresh requires credentials:include and an exact trusted Origin; frontend must serialize refresh calls.
